name: Koizumi Ryou
source:
Hobbies: None (because he's a [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/R%C5%8Dnin_(student)]ronin[/url])
Likes: None (because he's a ronin)
Dislikes: Studying for exams

A young man who lives alone in the town of Chisakura. Ryou has failed to pursue higher education and is unemployed, therefore he spends his days looking for a part-time job along with his best friend [url=/c118022]Kazuya[/url]. Despite Ryou's frail appearance, he is so fast that even the vampire twins [url=/c12952]Mayu[/url] and [url=/c12953]Mana[/url] have a hard time catching up with him.
